headline: Egypt Urges Localisation of Water Equipment and Private Sector Partnerships
summary: Egyptian Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly called for the domestic manufacturing of drinking water and sanitation equipment alongside expanded private sector partnerships to support water security.
why: Egypt's government initiatives in infrastructure localisation aim to reduce import dependence and support industrial development.

impacts.name: Egyptian Infrastructure
impacts.why: Pushing for local equipment manufacturing and private partnerships creates domestic industrial opportunities in water projects.
